desc.ian_image_library:title: Local water transport (India)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Illustration of local water transport in India, commonly used on Chilika Lake which is a brackish water lagoon spread over the Puri, Khurda and Ganjam districts of Odisha state on the east coast of India.
